question: How many unique sessions visited the /regist/input page and then the /regist/confirm page, in that order?
sql:
WITH input_sessions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, MIN(stamp) as first_input
    FROM form_log
    WHERE path = '/regist/input'
    GROUP BY session
),
confirm_sessions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, MIN(stamp) as first_confirm
    FROM form_log
    WHERE path = '/regist/confirm'
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as unique_sessions
FROM input_sessions i
JOIN confirm_sessions c ON i.session = c.session
WHERE i.first_input < c.first_confirm

args.sql:
WITH input_sessions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, MIN(stamp) as first_input
    FROM form_log
    WHERE path = '/regist/input'
    GROUP BY session
),
confirm_sessions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, MIN(stamp) as first_confirm
    FROM form_log
    WHERE path = '/regist/confirm'
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as unique_sessions
FROM input_sessions i
JOIN confirm_sessions c ON i.session = c.session
WHERE i.first_input < c.first_confirm
